strategy.thesis: Originally Bertelsmann's wholly-owned Asia corporate-VC arm (est. 2008); rebranded BAI Capital after raising its first externally-backed $700M fund in 2022. Generalist China/Asia growth investor (retail, fintech, content, EVs) with a repeat pattern of digital-health and consumer-health deals (Chunyu Doctor, Keep) rather than a dedicated health practice.

summary.en: China-focused growth investor founded 2008 as Bertelsmann's wholly-owned Asia CVC arm, rebranded BAI Capital after closing a $700M fund with external LPs in 2022; over 200 portfolio companies (Nio, Mobike) with a generalist tech/consumer mandate that has repeatedly touched digital health (Chunyu Doctor) and consumer health/fitness (Keep).
